Body.Content:
Team member license holders of Project Operations can now use new views to track project-level staffing (including bookings) and weekly task-level assignments. These views provide real-time visibility into planned work and allow users to break task assignments into subtasks (personal milestones) to better manage timelines.

With these capabilities, project team members can plan their work more effectively, prepare for timely onboarding to new projects, and align time tracking more closely with staffing.

These views will continue to evolve, with upcoming monthly releases introducing additional capabilities such as simplified time logging and timeline or time-phased staffing views.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/time/enhanced-team-member-experience

GA date: October CY2026

Preview date: April CY2026
